question: What type of governance structure was proposed in the draft National Air Sports Policy (NASP) by the Ministry of Civil Aviation in January 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**two-tier.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Civil Aviation **proposed a **two-tiered governance **structure for the **National Air Sports Policy **(NASP) draft in **January 2022.**
 
• The two-tiered governance structure comprises of a **National Air Sports Council** (NASC) and a **National Air Sports Management Committee (NASMC).**
 
• The NASC will be the apex body responsible for **policy formulation** and overall guidance, whereas the NASMC will be responsible for **implementation and monitoring** of the policy.
 
• The NASP aims to promote **air sports** in India and provide a framework for the development of air sports infrastructure,** training, and safety** measures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Air Sports Policy** (NASP) is a policy framework proposed by the** Ministry of Civil Aviation** to promote air sports in India.
 
• The goal outlined in NASP 2022 is to position India by **2030** as one of the world's leading sports nations.
 
• The National Air Sports Council (NASC) will have representatives from various** ministries, regulatory bodies, and industry stakeholders**, while the National Air Sports Management Committee (NASMC) will have **representatives from the NASC **and other relevant **stakeholders.**
